name: Candice Catnipp (Vollstandig)

skills.description:
Candice performs a lightning-infused melee combo, dealing 4 hits for a total damage equal to 310% of ATK and generating Spiritual Pressure. 
 When the fourth hit lands, she gains 1 point(s) of Charge Up. ~~Galvano Javelin~~ Vollstandig state 
 Candice swings the Galvano Javelin before hurling it, dealing 4 hits for a total damage equal to 390% of ATK and generating Spiritual Pressure. 
 Landing the 4th hit grants 1 point(s) of Charge Up. ~~Lightning Bombardment~~ At max Spiritual Pressure, tap Basic Attack after releasing the 4th hit of Basic Attack 
 Candice leaps high into the air, gathers lightning, and crashes down on the enemy, dealing damage equal to 600% of ATK. 
 Upon release, she gains 1 point(s) of Charge Up.
skills.name: Thunder Strike

skills.description:
Candice leaps backward and fires a powerful shockwave from her Heilig Bogen, dealing damage equal to 630% and generating Spiritual Pressure. 
 Upon release, she gains 1 point(s) of Charge Up. 
 Tap Basic Attack after release to immediately follow up with the 4th Basic Attack Hit. ~~Lightning Flash~~ While in Vollstandig, consume 1 Charge Up 
 Candice charges at the enemy with her Galvano Javeling, dealing damage equal to 160% of ATK. 
 Upon release, she gains 1 point(s) of Reishi Charge. ~~Lightning Flash - Finale~~ When Reishi Charge reaches its maximum 
 Candice consumes all Reishi Charge and performs a series of lightning-charged dashes toward the enemy before delivering a final strike, dealing damage equal to 800% of ATK.
skills.name: Galvano Blast

skills.description:
At the backline, Candice gathers lightning before entering the battlefield and launching a firce assault, dealing damage equal to 1200% of ATK and gaining 1 point(s) of Charge Up. ~~Twin Lightning~~ When in Vollstandig and in the backline with maximum Spiritual Pressure 
 At the backline, Candice enters the battlefield wielding her Galvano Javelin, dealing damage equal to 1200% of ATK and gaining 1 point(s) of Charge Up.
skills.name: Energy Shift

skills.description:
Candice activates Sklave Rai and enters Vollstandig, dealing damage equal to 900% of ATK and gaining 1 point(s) of Charge Up. ~~Electrocution~~ Vollstandig state 
 Candice unleashes her amassed lightning at the enemy in a devastating execution strike, dealing damage equal to 1420% of ATK, and grants herself and Finesse teammates the bonus Ion Surge: Increases Crit DMG by (number of Finesse teammates x 50%) for 45 seconds, then exits Vollstandig Form
skills.name: Quincy: Vollstandig

skills.description:
After countering an enemy attack, Candice calls down multiple lightning bolts at the enemy's location, dealing damage equal to 660% of ATK. 
 Successfully countering an enemy's Spiritual Pressure Attack grants 1 point(s) of Charge Up. ~~Galvano Retaliation~~ In Vollstandig state 
 After countering an enemy attack, Candice launches a series of rapid assaults, dealing damage equal to 660% of ATK. 
 Successfully countering an enemy's Spiritual Pressure Attack grants 1 point(s) of Charge Up.
skills.name: Counterattack

skills.description:
Use Hirenkyaku to avoid attacks right before they hit. 
 Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Candice gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds.
skills.name: Hirenkyaku

The ATK Boost granted by Electrofield Boost (via Passive Boost - Electrofield) is increased by an additional 1%.
The Crit Rate Boost granted by Passive Boost - High Voltage is increased by an additional 1.5%.
Releasing the Ultimate - Quincy: Vollstandig grants 1 extra Charge Up.

rationale: 138.4% Ult charge should be enough to use her normally, more than 190% will let you skip some parts of her animation, allowing for faster rotation.
33000 HP is required to benefit fully from her buffs/passives.
